column1: # benchmark/cases.tsv — CodeWiki agent-savings case matrix (canonical, merged).
# 157 cases over 11 real cold-clonable repos: 8 per-language repos (one per language), a
# large .NET repo (jellyfin, ~2,065 .cs), and 2 enterprise repos (kubernetes ~17k files,
# microsoft/TypeScript ~39k files). This is the single canonical case file: it merges the
# original 6-archetype-per-language base suite with two waves of DEEPER cases
# (Python/Rust/TS/JS and C#/Java/C++/Go) that stress harder, more representative tasks —
# ambiguous/overloaded/common names, interface->impls (DI base lists + structural Go
# interfaces), generics/templates, deep multi-hop blast radius, framework patterns, larger
# feature comprehension — plus the enterprise + large .NET tiers. Hard / expected-to-lose
# cases (overloaded names, deep `feature` comprehension, high-fanout blast radius) are kept
# on purpose to expose real limitations, not cherry-picked to win. (The recall-aggregation
# + C# type-reference + Go structural-interface fixes closed the two former empty-oracle
# graph-gap cases — C# EfRepository blast, Go Reconciler impl — which now resolve to real
# graph-derived oracles and are scored like any other case.)
#   locate   "where is X defined"          CW: search       | BL: grep def + read 1 file
#   callers  "what calls X"                CW: callers      | BL: grep usages + read N files
#   callees  "what does X call"            CW: callees      | BL: read X's body + grep
#   feature  "how does <feature> work"     CW: context (x3) | BL: grep feature regex + read N files
#   impl     "implementers/subtypes of X"  CW: impact       | BL: grep interface + read N impl files
#   blast    "what breaks if X changes"    CW: impact       | BL: grep symbol + read N dependant files
#   lang  repo  archetype  symbol  feature_query  baseline_regex  oracle_anchors  case_id
# - symbol         : the named symbol the CW tool is invoked with (and grep baseline targets)
# - feature_query  : NL task for the `feature` archetype's `context` call (empty otherwise)
# - baseline_regex : the grep -E pattern the baseline agent would run for this task
# - oracle_anchors : '|'-joined anchor symbol names for the `feature` archetype oracle
#                    (empty for other archetypes; their oracle is derived from the graph)
# - case_id        : globally-unique id; oracle is oracle/<lang>_<case_id>.json
# Build oracles + run:  benchmark/lib/build_oracle_extra.py --cases benchmark/cases.tsv --out benchmark/oracle
